violated_contract: A health or liveness value summarising several independent components must not report healthy while any component the user believes is running has stopped; an aggregate computed as "at least one member is live" is read by every caller as "every member is live", so one working sensor answers for a dead one and the outage becomes unobservable.
canonical_prevention: Derive the aggregate from a total per-component state map inside the type that publishes it, so "capturing while a component is blocked" is unrepresentable rather than merely untrue; keep each component's own reason attached to that component instead of a single top-level nullable string a healthy aggregate can discard, and distinguish a capability never granted from one this install has used and lost so the second can be reported as a regression.
